changes.text: Diff tab: text is selected in either column and copied
Side bar lists scroll sideways: a bar at the bottom and Shift+wheel
Git history: commits stay open, and the active tab's commit file is revealed
Build: stop only the dist copy of workpad.exe before replacing it
Editor groups: split the editor right or down, again from a split one
Explorer: a new file or folder may be a path, a/b/c.txt - the missing folders on the way are made
Explorer: dragging with Ctrl held copies - into the same folder as "a copy.txt"
Explorer: the active editor's file is revealed in the tree - folders expanded, selected, scrolled to
Git history: a commit's context menu copies its whole message or its hash
State: state.toml is replaced whole under a lock between windows, a broken tail dropped on reading
